name: manual_d37ed8
claim: Firecrawl setup uses two parts: (1) npm install -g firecrawl-mcp for the MCP server binary, and (2) 'firecrawl init --all -k <key>' for the CLI + 32 agent skills. MCP is configured as a remote HTTP server at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp with the API key embedded in the URL; use 'firecrawl setup mcp -y --agent <name>' for each harness.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14: Installed firecrawl across claude-code, codex, cursor, windsurf, and 7 other harnesses. The MCP server runs as a remote HTTP endpoint, not local stdio.
